name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, April 04, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
a.
Call Meeting to Order
3.
PRESENTATIONS
A.
Parks & Recreation Commission Update
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
Prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-e, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting held on March 21, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item # 7c
d.
Adopt Ordinance No. 786
ORD 786 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, ADOPTING REFERENCE TITLE 32- FIRE CODE OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE AMENDING SECTION 3-1 ( FIRE PREVENTION) INCORPORATING THE 2016 EDITION OF THE CALIFORNIA FIRE CODE WITH CERTAIN CHANGES AND AMENDMENTS AND MAKING OTHER REVISIONS THERETO. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That the City Council Adopt Ordinance No. 786.
Item #7d
e.
Consideration and Possible Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with O'Neil Ventures, Inc., to Provide Business Consulting and Restaurant and Retail Food Establishment Broker Services.
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute the Professional Services Agreement.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
Item #7e
8.
SCHEDULE A DATE AND TIME FOR THE FY 2017-2018 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND FY 2017-2018 BUDGET PUBLIC HEARING
Presented by Administrative Services Kamada
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Select one of the following dates for the FY 2017-2018 Budget Workshop: Monday, May 15, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
Wednesday, May 17, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
Thursday, May 18,, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
2)
Schedule the FY 2017-2018 Budget Public Hearing on Tuesday, June 20, 2017 at 6:30 p.m.
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, April 18, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
